Left Arm, Laceration: Apply direct pressure to the left arm with a sterile dressing. Elevate the arm above the heart. Do not use a tourniquet unless bleeding is severe.
Head, Burn: Cool the burn immediately with cool running water. Do not apply pressure to the head. Cover loosely.
Right Leg, Sprain: Follow RICE for the right leg. Rest, apply ice, compress with an elastic bandage, and elevate.
